The '''Northwest Coromons''' were a group of islands belonging to the [[Coromon Islands]] chain.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> The [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] [[INCOM Corp. Customer Service Bureau|Customer Service Bureau]] was located on one of these islands.<ref name="SWRPG 1st">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
